data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): pass_record.json schema PIN — required keys: phase (string), pass_index (int), mutation_count (int), timestamp (ISO8601). Schema source: upstream bootstrap.py / reconcile.py emission point. Add RED test test_pass_record_schema_strict: fixture pass_record.json missing 'mutation_count' field → exit non-zero (KeyError surfaces as prerequisite failure, NOT silent 0-mutation pass). If schema not yet pinned upstream (draft-7 reconcile.py owns it), this task has prerequisite dependency: confirm bootstrap.py emits all 4 fields before task-4 RED tests can run. Rationale: validation-class audits that silently pass on schema drift are highest-risk failure mode for this story (implicit_assumption).
